attributes.bloc_1_text: Buy and sell shares in extraordinary art on the world’s first Multilateral Trading Facility (MTF) regulated for fine art by the Financial Market Authority (FMA) in Liechtenstein and compliant with the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID II). <b/>Listed masterpieces will be displayed in museums around the world for all to appreciate.
attributes.fractionnality_text: Most people will never have the opportunity to own an artwork with a value exceeding $100M, however, ARTEX is giving everyone the opportunity to part-own iconic masterpiece paintings with a starting nominal value of $100 a share. By trading on ARTEX’s MTF, investors will be able to draw financial rewards and see their chosen artworks exhibited publicly.
attributes.index_etf_text: ARTEX will built the first Art Tradable Index. The first listing on the MTF will be the building blocks of this index and the foundation of our future ETF trading.
attributes.liquidity_text: An opportunity to participate in a unique asset class with daily liquidity provided by dedicated market makers, tighter spreads, and frictionless trading.
attributes.materiality_text: Art is a tangible, physical asset. Investing in art can be viewed as investing in gold but with less volatility, and more social impact.
attributes.regulation_text: ARTEX is authorised and regulated by the Financial Market Authority (FMA) in the Principality of Liechtenstein, which is subject to the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID II).
attributes.scarcity_text: The main driver of performance is the lack of supply. As our investor base grows, we anticipate that investment activity and value will rise.
attributes.social_impact_text: Philanthropy: promoting and preserving our heritage through partnerships with cultural institutions around the world.
